meta.name: Feludar Goyendagiri
meta.description: In the exquisite but bloodied snowscape of Kashmir, Feluda, Topshe, and Jatayu encounter a chilling mystery as a retired judge is murdered. Now Feluda has to navigate multiple suspects and political tension to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Dhundhumar Darjeeling
videos.overview: Feluda, Topshe and Lalmohan reach Darjeeling on Pulak Ghoshal's invitation. The trio meet Birupakkho Majumdar during a stroll in the Darjeeling Mall.

videos.title: Birupakkho Brittanto
videos.overview: Birupakhkho Majumdar reveals some uncanny facts about his life. Pulak Ghoshal makes Lalmohan an unusual but tempting offer.

videos.title: Shooting-ey Shihoron
videos.overview: During the shooting, Lalmohan overhears Birupakhkho berating someone. The next day, a piece of news leaves the trio in shock.

videos.title: Taalmaatal Tawdonto
videos.overview: Feluda detects some crucial clues at the crime scene and also gets to know about Birupakhkho's dark past. An unknown man pushes Feluda off a cliff.

videos.title: Himalaye Hotyakando
videos.overview: Birupakhkho's former doctor reveals the strained relationships in the Majumdar family. While Feluda interrogates the suspects, Topshe and Lalmohan discover something startling in the jungle.

videos.title: Jawmjawmat Jawbonika
videos.overview: Feluda rounds up all those with both motive and opportunity for murder and unmasks everyone one by one.

videos.title: S2.E1 ∙ Ebaar Kando Kashmir-a
videos.overview: Feluda, Topshe, and Lalmohan Babu travel to Kashmir for a holiday and meet retired judge Siddeshwar Mallik.

videos.title: S2.E2 ∙ Holiday-te Gondogol
videos.overview: Siddeshwar invites the trio to one of his nocturnal psychic sessions. Later that night, Feluda faces a vicious attack.

videos.title: S2.E3 ∙ Planchette-a Kelenkari
videos.overview: Bijoy reveals his vices to everyone. Another intense session with the judge thickens the plot.

videos.title: S2.E4 ∙ Pahalgam-a Khunkharapi
videos.overview: While several mysteries keep swirling, an unnatural death shakes everyone to the core.

videos.title: S2.E5 ∙ Onushawndhan Jawmjawmat
videos.overview: Feluda tracks down the mysterious man with a rifle. The murder investigation reveals details that make everyone a suspect.

videos.title: S2.E6 ∙ Bhuswargo Bhoyonkawr
videos.overview: When everyone has a motive, it's up to Feluda to wield the power of his magajastra and unmask the killer.

videos.title: Jekhane Bagh er Bhoy
videos.overview: Feluda visits Mahitosh Singha Ray’s mansion with Topshe and Jatayu, but senses a hidden mystery in the jungle.

videos.title: Shikari Singha Roy
videos.overview: Mahitoshbabu reveals his family's tiger hunting legacy and challenges Feluda ith a puzzle hiding deeper jungle secret

videos.title: Shanketer Shondhane
videos.overview: Feluda thinks over the riddle, meets a strange man, and as Torit babu dies, a deeper jungle secret waits to be found

videos.title: Kalbunite Kelengkari
videos.overview: Was it a tiger or murder? Is the riddle linked to Torit Babu's death? What secret hides inside the mansion?

videos.title: Hotyar hatiyar
videos.overview: The sword is missing. Feluda finds clues from Torit's room and Debtosh's words. The riddle begins to unravel.

videos.title: Joto Kando Jongole
videos.overview: On the day Torit Babu died, someone died in the jungle. Feluda wonders if it was connected to the hidden treasure.

videos.title: Aranye Ashini
videos.overview: Treasure found, killer beast appears. Feluda unravels Torit's death and Mohitoshbabu's secret. Can he save them all?
